assign.outcome:
**One knob landed.** `framework.css` now has `--size` (0.75 / 1 / 1.5) and one `:where(*)` block for `--pad`/`--gap`/`--flow`, `cqi` in place of `vw`. The old six-name system — `--pad-ramp`/`--gap-ramp`/`--flow-ramp`, `*-default`, `--spacing`, `.spacing-tight`/`.spacing-airy` — is deleted, not aliased. `.size-small`/`.size-regular`/`.size-large` now do both jobs: a control's own height (landed today by `ui-theme`) and every box's pad/gap/rhythm.

**957 renames applied** across 166 files (873 by scripted sweep over 160 `.css`/`page.js` files, 27 in `Page.css`, 7 in two sibling `.js` files holding literal CSS strings, 46 in `framework.css` itself, 4 in a local self-reference fix). Two real bugs hid inside the mechanical rename and needed a human, not a sed: `--flow: var(--flow-default)` and `.page-previews{--gap: var(--gap-default)}` both collapse to `--x: var(--x)` once the two-tier naming merges — a property defined in terms of itself, invalid in CSS. Both fixed by hand; a third (`.layouts-tight`/`.layouts-airy` wanting 0.5x/2x of the ambient default) now inlines the raw clamp instead.

**Proof, live at :8123, no injection:** the 20 audit-page medians match the study's candidate within 1px at 1280 (5.26/7.9/28.75 vs 5.4/7.9/28.8) and close at 3440 (6.3/19.78/48.6 vs 6.5/20.8/48.6 — gap 1px off, four other tasks edited these same pages since the study ran). Three containers deep at 3440, reading text holds 18/18/18px. `.size-small`/`.size-large` visibly change pad/gap/rhythm on the [size page](/imagine/design/size/) — screenshots in this dir. [Controls](/framework/ui/controls/) re-measured at the new ladder: 27.06/36.09/**54.14**px at 1280, exact 0.75x/1.5x. Crawl of `/`, `/framework/`, `/imagine/`, `/notes/`, `/blog/` at 400/1280/1920/3440: **zero console errors** (one pre-existing, unrelated 404 on a page that no longer exists).

**Left, with reasons.** Six readme/doc `.md` files outside the `.css`/`page.js` fence (`styles/readme.md`, `core/Layout/doc/rules.md`, `core/Page/readme.md`, `ext/tabs/doc/decisions.md`, `imagine/paging/doc/decisions.md`, `imagine/sections/readme.md`) still name the old tokens — now stale, a documentation-pass follow-up. The size study's own history pages (`ceilings`, `one-rule`, `spacing/audit`, `spacing/page.js`, and `decision.md` beyond its one added line) keep the old names on purpose, as the record of what they used to be.
